text:
maya: Heads-up — saw orphaned metric buckets on the Insights dashboard after the rollout. org A is showing counts that belong to other orgs when I toggle quickfilters.
devon: Can you repro and share a screenshot? Which filter?
maya: Steps to repro: 1) open /insights -> select org A -> apply `projects:all` -> set range to 7d -> total counts jump and show +50 rows. I pulled the collector logs and noticed `tenant_id` missing from aggregation key in a few entries.
andre: That sounds like the shard-agg v2 change we pushed yesterday. We changed key composition from `tenant_id|metric|bucket` -> `metric|bucket` to reduce cardinality. If that's true, it would explain cross-tenant mixing.
infra-bot: deploy bot: v2-shard-agg rolled to prod, canary 30% (deployed at 2025-06-12T03:40Z).
liz: If metrics are mixed, billing and quota reporting could be affected too. @devon can you check the internal router headers? Maybe `x-tenant` is being stripped before the collector merges keys.
devon: Looking at traces now — trace id `abc123` shows internal call to `/metrics/aggregate` with headers: `x-tenant: 1234` present, but payload shows `aggregation_key` without tenant. Example payload snippet: { "aggregation_key": "insights:usage:daily:2025-06-11", "value": 5 } — so header present but key composition done earlier in pipeline.
maya: That suggests the problem is in the collector pre-processing step (instrumentation library) that composes the aggregation key before the header is attached or passed through.
andre: Quick mitigation: server-side collector should fallback to prefixing tenant if available on request. Longer term, revert the aggressive key compaction. We also need to handle historical double-counted buckets.
maya: Can we rollback the canary? infra-bot shows 30% live. If we can flip back to 0% and hotfix, that minimizes blast radius.
devon: I'll prepare a rollback PR and hotfix. Also proposing an assert in the collector: `if not aggregation_key.startswith(tenant_id): raise` (fails fast in staging/e2e).
liz: We should notify finance and support — this may affect invoices if meters are aggregated across tenants. Ops, can you surface any customer tickets?
ops: On it. Opening incident INC-7421 and pinging support ops. Will gather affected customer list and ETA.
andre: Action plan: 1) pause canary immediately 2) hotfix collector to compose key as `tenant_id|metric|bucket` 3) create backfill job to remap orphaned buckets into tenant-scoped buckets 4) add unit tests + e2e for header->key composition. Rough ETA: 3-4 hours for hotfix + deploy.
devon: Also adding a telemetry metric `console.aggregation.missing_tenant` (Prometheus) and an alert if rate > 0 for >5m.
maya: Good call. Add a per-tenant diff job to detect negative/positive adjustments post-backfill so we can reconcile billing.
liz: Can we also post a short status note in the console UI: "We're investigating an insights metrics discrepancy; numbers may be inaccurate"? ops: can you publish a status page note?
ops: Yes, posting now and sending to oncall.
andre: I'll assign the PRs and the backfill task in INC-7421. Thanks for catching this, @maya :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all. keeping ticket updated.
